title: Ringo Starr and his All-Starr Band live: Music Box, Atlantic City | 2018
content:
Ringo Starr and his All-Starr Band performed at the Music Box at the Borgata Hotel Casino and Spa in Atlantic City, New Jersey, USA, on 1 June 2018.

Embed from Getty Images

It was the first show of the 13th All-Starr Band’s tour of Europe and North America, which lasted for 44 dates between June and September 2018.

Hanging out with Henry Diltz. the last Hippie standing we had a great show last night we’re on the road again playing Atlantic City again tonight at the. Borgata peace and love ??????????? pic.twitter.com/eSI3tw0Ray

— #RingoStarr (@ringostarrmusic) June 2, 2018

Watch versions of Starr’s song ‘It Don’t Come Easy’ and The Beatles’ ‘What Goes On’ from the Atlantic City show:
